beats.narration_text: Bonjour — this is Liam, in for Komal, for Madison's weekly update. Team Madison has two tracks this week. Loon Conservatory: expand the annotation tool beyond loons, and find a conservatory partner. Plus new project ideas — including the Jungian Ruler detector. Next week's meeting chooses.
